flags.finding: Bookmaker odds never appear in the OLBG pages retrieved on 2026-10-27. Listings print the selection, market, tip split and percentage, but the price column is empty and event pages show 'WIN @' with nothing after it; the prices are rendered client-side.
flags.impact: No bookmaker price is quoted anywhere on this site. Every price is originated by this desk from the printed tip split (CAL-1), and the -250 to +10000 focus band is applied to our own numbers.

flags.finding: 15 of the 19 OLBG handball money-line rows print 'Tie' as the most-tipped selection, including heavyweight club fixtures. A draw consensus across most of a round is not a credible market signal.
flags.impact: No 'Tie' pick is published and those splits are not used. Only the four rows with a real club selection (VasterasIrsta 2/4, Skovde 2/4, HBW Balingen-Weilstetten 1/1, Skanderborg 1/3) are priced and picked, all at low confidence.

flags.finding: Both https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Snooker/8 and its all-events variant returned 'No tips found' on 2026-10-27, and the sport filter rendered as 'All Sports' rather than 'Snooker'.
flags.impact: Zero snooker events, lines and picks. No line is originated where there is no printed market; the sport page states this plainly instead of padding.

flags.finding: Both https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Greyhounds/28 and its all-events variant returned 'No tips found' on 2026-10-27. The previous day's card had carried race rows, so this is a same-week gap rather than a permanent empty sport.
flags.impact: Zero greyhound events, lines and picks on today's board. The sport page states the gap instead of inventing race cards.

flags.finding: OLBG cards South Africa v Australia (3rd Test) for 31 October 04:30, while ESPNcricinfo's schedule lists the Cape Town Test as starting on 27 October. The two sources disagree by four days.
flags.impact: The event is inventoried with OLBG's date because OLBG is the board's primary source, and it is not picked. A human should reconcile the two schedules before any staking decision.

flags.finding: Some OLBG card pairings do not appear in ESPN's first-round draw as retrieved (for example Borges v Ruud at Basel is not on the ESPN R1 board, and the Djokovic/Humbert pairing seen on earlier cards is absent). OLBG and the tour draw appear out of step on individual ties.
flags.impact: Tennis write-ups assert only the tournament, round and facts visible on the specific ESPN event page actually retrieved, and do not assert head-to-head history beyond what OLBG prints.

flags.finding: The high bar requires at least 70% fair chance, at least 8 tips and a fair decimal price inside 1.40-101.00. 25 rows have 8+ tips but none clears all three gates. Near-misses: Afghanistan 0.818 fair but 1.22 fair price (outside band); Eire Og Cor 0.750 but only 6 tips and 1.33 fair price; Fernandez 0.722 but 1.38 fair price; Ziraat Bankasi and Osaka at 0.700 with only 4 tips; India 0.691 and Pakistan 0.676 inside the band but below the 70% gate.
flags.impact: The high-confidence tier is empty by construction rather than downgraded by hand. The near-misses remain published at medium confidence with the reason visible in their numbers.

flags.finding: The EHF Champions League competition site could not be retrieved during this session (page fetch failed), so no independent form, squad or standings source supports the handball picks.
flags.impact: All four handball predictions rely solely on OLBG-printed splits, make no form or injury claim, and are published at low confidence with this gap stated on each card.

flags.finding: PDC.tv returned only a cookie-consent wall with no fixture or player content, so no independent source corroborates the two darts markets.
flags.impact: Both darts picks (Luke Littler 22/36, Nathan Aspinall 2/8) rely on OLBG-printed splits alone and state no form claims beyond them.

flags.finding: The URC fixtures-and-results URL returned 404; only the unitedrugby.com homepage (Round 4 review and Round 5 countdown) and the Furlong disciplinary article were reachable. The Pro D2 fixtures carry no independent source at all.
flags.impact: URC picks use only the two reachable official pages plus OLBG; the three Pro D2 picks cite OLBG alone and are labelled low/medium accordingly.

flags.finding: 28 of the 49 written predictions rest on four tips or fewer, and four rest on a single tip. The small samples are a property of OLBG's card, not of our selection process.
flags.impact: Shrinkage pulls those rows toward the market prior, so they price close to even money and are labelled low or medium. They are published for completeness, not as conviction bets.

flags.finding: 11 picks sit in outright or tournament markets (three golf, two darts, two Gaelic, two rugby league, two motor racing) where OLBG does not print the number of runners. The engine assumes eight runners (prior 1/8).
flags.impact: These prices are assumption-sensitive: a larger real field means the prior is too generous and the fair price is too short. Every such row is labelled with the 'outright assumed 8 runners' structure on the pricing table.

flags.finding: The T20 Blast 2027 outright row (event 188350) printed no tip split or percentage at retrieval.
flags.impact: It is listed in the inventory and on the sport's event table but deliberately left unpriced; 142 of 143 inventoried events carry a line. No number is guessed.

flags.finding: OLBG runs Gaelic Football (sport id 25) and Hurling (sport id 26) as two separate sports while the brief lists one 'Gaelic Sports' sport.
flags.impact: Both pages are inventoried and combined on one Gaelic Sports page, with the OLBG sport id visible on every row so the split is auditable.

flags.finding: OLBG prints no timezone on its start labels, and some labels differ from official governing-body schedules. OLBG times are snapshots at retrieval and tip totals move as new tips arrive.
flags.impact: Every time is quoted exactly as OLBG printed it and is not treated as a settled local kick-off. Where an official schedule was retrieved (F1, PGA, URC, ESPN cards) it is given in the fact list on the relevant card.

flags.impact: 49 predictions are published against a 75-pick target. The shortfall is named on the dashboard, each sport page and here, rather than filled with invented fixtures or prices.
